1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FacetCornerNeighbors
2 import Mathlib.Geometry.Euclidean.Triangle
3 
4 /-! Ordinary interior angles of original faces. The definition uses the
5 two original edges at a corner; it is zero away from that face. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.Face
8 
9 open Set EuclideanGeometry
10 
11 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (F : P.Face)
12 
13 /-- The two original edges bounding a face at one of its vertices. -/
14 structure CornerNeighbors (v : P.Vertex) where
15   left : P.Vertex
16   right : P.Vertex
17   distinct : left ≠ right
18   at_vertex : (v : Space) ∈ F.val
19   left_mem : (left : Space) ∈ F.val
20   right_mem : (right : Space) ∈ F.val
21   left_edge : P.edgeGraph.Adj v left
22   right_edge : P.edgeGraph.Adj v right
23   exhaust : ∀ w : P.Vertex, (w : Space) ∈ F.val → P.edgeGraph.Adj v w →
24     w = left ∨ w = right
25 
26 /-- Every corner of a triangular or quadrilateral face has such a pair. -/
27 theorem cornerNeighbors_nonempty
28     (small : (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
29       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
30     (v : P.Vertex) (on_face : (v : Space) ∈ F.val) : Nonempty (F.CornerNeighbors v) := by
31   obtain ⟨b, edge, bF⟩ := F.exists_corner_edge small v on_face
32   obtain ⟨c, different, edge_c, cF, exhaust⟩ :=
33     F.exists_other_corner_neighbor small v b edge on_face bF
34   exact ⟨⟨b, c, different.symm, on_face, bF, cF, edge, edge_c, exhaust⟩⟩
35 
36 /-- The ordinary face angle; absent corners contribute zero to sums. -/
37 noncomputable def cornerAngle (v : P.Vertex) : ℝ := by
38   classical
39   exact if h : Nonempty (F.CornerNeighbors v) then
40     angle ((Classical.choice h).left : Space) v (Classical.choice h).right else 0
41 
42 theorem cornerAngle_of_not_mem (v : P.Vertex) (outside : (v : Space) ∉ F.val) :
43     F.cornerAngle v = 0 := by
44   classical
45   have empty : ¬ Nonempty (F.CornerNeighbors v) := fun ⟨pair⟩ => outside pair.at_vertex
46   simp only [cornerAngle, dif_neg empty]
47 
48 /-- Computing the face angle is independent of the chosen ordering of its two edges. -/
49 theorem cornerAngle_eq
50     (small : (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
51       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
52     (v b c : P.Vertex) (distinct : b ≠ c)
53     (vF : (v : Space) ∈ F.val) (bF : (b : Space) ∈ F.val) (cF : (c : Space) ∈ F.val)
54     (vb : P.edgeGraph.Adj v b) (vc : P.edgeGraph.Adj v c) :
55     F.cornerAngle v = angle (b : Space) v c := by
56   classical
57   have exists_pair := F.cornerNeighbors_nonempty small v vF
58   rw [cornerAngle, dif_pos exists_pair]
59   let pair := Classical.choice exists_pair
60   change angle (pair.left : Space) v pair.right = angle (b : Space) v c
61   rcases pair.exhaust b bF vb with rfl | rfl <;>
62     rcases pair.exhaust c cF vc with rfl | rfl
63   · exact (distinct rfl).elim
64   · rfl
65   · exact angle_comm _ _ _
66   · exact (distinct rfl).elim
67 
68 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.Face
